text: "I want to get a shave." "All right," said Drouet, creaking off in his good shoes toward the elevator. The old butterfly was as light on the wing as ever. * * * * * On an incoming vestibuled Pullman, speeding at forty miles an hour through the snow of the evening, were three others, all related. "First call for dinner in the dining-car," a Pullman servitor was announcing, as he hastened through the aisle in snow-white apron and jacket.
